chunks: When you and those with you have boarded the ark, say: 'All praise be to God who has delivered us from the people who were sinful.'

key_terms.الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ: the oppressive people / the people who were sinful

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication to recite when boarding the ark according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific supplication of Prophet Nuh (AS) and his followers, emphasizing that true salvation involves not just physical rescue but spiritual gratitude for deliverance from the 'oppressive' (Zalimin) who rejected divine guidance. The phrase 'the people who were oppressive' is interpreted by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as referring to those who imposed their will through tyranny and denial, making this du'a a model for recognizing God's favor in overcoming both external trials and internal spiritual stagnation.
